analysis:
Examined base-side units of MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift lines 1000-2053. These units cover the following:
- The text submit path through the v2 bridge (1013-1068), with cacheScope -> cacheSalt plumbing at 1037 (T-041).
- The GLM/Qwen/MiMo cluster media paths (1115-1438), which use cacheEnabled:false. MiMo draft cluster images use cacheEnabled:true at 1363; that line is unchanged and in-scope.
- makeDeadlineCheckedEventStream and makeEventStream release/cancel paths (1455-1912).
- yieldTerminalInfo, the tokenize/detokenize/applyTemplate endpoints and tokenizer resolution.

The complete range map shows changes in these units only at head 1043-1044 and 1426-1428 and base 1422. Head text for those ranges is not supplied. They likely correspond to stopStringScope (ReasoningStopScope) additions, mirroring the media patch at head 789-799/821-823. That patch seeds the think parser from the rendered prompt and passes stopStringScope to bridge.submitTokenized. These are output-parsing and stop-string scoping changes, not cache-salt, encryption, attestation or billing changes. Base line 1422 (multimodal submit args in prepareNativeMiMoMedia) is replaced; cacheEnabled remains false at 1421 in base.

No regression was identified in the visible base code:
- Release-on-every-exit paths remain intact.
- Cancellation propagation (T-010) is unchanged.
- The cacheScope is still coordinator-authored, not caller-derived, at 1037/1139/1235/1313/1363/1421.

Open questions for integration:
- Verify that head 1043-1044 does not alter the cacheScope/cacheEnabled arguments, and that 1426-1428 keep cacheEnabled:false for native media.
- Verify that ReasoningStopScope does not let reasoning-channel content bypass withholding (withholdReasoning/GLM JSON withholding) or leak withheld reasoning to clients.
- Confirm that the bridge-side stopStringScope implementation (EngineV2Bridge, not supplied) handles a nil or invalid scope safely.
